description: Pantry moths can quickly contaminate dry foods such as flour, rice, cereals and grains if left unnoticed. InsectiX Pantry Moth Traps are designed to help detect and monitor food moth activity early, protecting your kitchen cupboards and stored food before problems spread. Using a specialised pheromone lure, these pheromone pantry moth traps attract male food moths and capture them on a discreet sticky surface. This allows you to identify moth presence and monitor activity levels in cupboards, cabinets and food storage areas. Designed for use as cupboard moth traps, kitchen moth traps and pantry moth traps, they are ideal for monitoring moth activity around dry food such as flour, grains, rice, pasta, cereals, nuts and pet food. These non toxic pantry moth traps are odourless and free from biocidal chemicals, making them suitable for use in kitchens and food storage areas when used as intended. No sprays, no fumes, no contamination of food. Each pantry moth monitoring trap provides long-lasting performance for up to 90 days, helping you track food moth activity over time and detect early signs of potential infestation. Simple to use and discreet in design, InsectiX pantry moth traps offer a reliable solution for ongoing moth monitoring in cupboards, kitchens and food storage spaces.
